verdict.rationale: Multilingual OCR fidelity is a fair question for a document-parsing API like Reducto, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions language support, CJK scripts, right-to-left scripts, or non-English accuracy. The parse docs cover multi-column text, tables, handwriting and rotated pages, and the OCR settings page covers timeouts and password-protected files; neither addresses languages or scripts.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English
